en.html:
I took a high guard.
The enemy was high as well, though its weapon rested over a shoulder with no particular care.

Then whoever got <ruby>beneath<rt>・</rt></ruby> the other would command the exchange. Below was where I had to be.

　敵もまた、無造作な肩担ぎの上段。

　ならば相手の<ruby>下<rt>・</rt></ruby>に潜った側が打ち合いを制する。

en.html:
An insane cry, and it charged with extraordinary force. The attack itself? Careless. Proper martial training, I could see none.
Getting underneath was no difficulty.

I passed beneath its belly and swung down.

ja.html:
気の触れたような叫びと共に押し寄せる敵騎は異様
なまでの勢威に溢れていたものの、攻撃の動作自体は
杜撰だった。まともな武術のそれではない。
　掻い潜るのは造作もなかった。

　敵騎の腹下に入りつつ、太刀を振り下ろす。

村正 《硬い……っ！》

en.html:
Such solid resistance, I had to clench my back teeth. Muramasa shook her steel in irritation.
That weighty appearance was not mere display, apparently. Some light swordplay would not settle this.

The exchange, nevertheless, was ours.
From here, bring it into our rhythm. Not much time should be needed—

ja.html:
強固な手応えに俺は奥歯を噛み、村正は忌々しげに
甲鉄を震わせた。
　敵の重厚な姿はどうやら見掛け倒しではないらしい。
少々の剣撃は通用しないようだ。

　しかしとにかくこの一合は制した。
　このままこちらの流れへ持っていければ、そう手間
取ることもなく――

en.html:
—My waist took a blow!

No great force in it. The damage was probably small.

But why had it struck at all!?
The axe's path I had cleared. That much was certain.

Yet just as we crossed, the attack came from <ruby>above<rt>・</rt></ruby>, from where the enemy was.
Which machine had delivered it, there was no doubt.

The means—what were the means!?

ja.html:
――腰に一撃を受けた！
　
　それほど重い攻撃ではない。損傷程度も僅少だろう。

　だが、何故だ!?
　斧の攻撃軌道からは確かに逃れた筈。

　だが――だが、攻撃を受けたのは間違いなく敵騎と
交差する瞬間、しかも敵のいる<ruby>上<rt>・</rt></ruby>からだった。
　疑う余地なく、敵の繰り出した攻撃なのだ。

　しかし！

en.html:
Even Muramasa, iron heart and all, could not hide her agitation.
The attack was that inexplicable.

What was it, then?
A hidden weapon? Some unusual bodily technique...?
